projects.title: BMW Plug And Charge mobile UX

points.observation: Research section states interviews with 15 BMW EV owners and 45-minute interviews; these are documented method claims.
High-level flow separates new versus returning users, BMW/Shell connection, payment and receipt paths.
Results distinguish first-time setup changing 7+ steps to 3–4, from returning users' charging time changing 2–3 minutes to at most 30 seconds.

cautions: One very tall physical page. Reviewed outline and independent research/flow/results zooms, not every tiny label.
Do not combine first-time and returning-user cohorts or change <=30 seconds into exactly 30 seconds.
Interview count does not automatically supply the denominator of every percentage displayed. Outcome text is a claim, not proof of causal improvement.
All-page visual contact-sheet review with text-layer aid where available. Independent source notes by Codex, not human expert or real-world truth verification.
